wo-jpfa-JR5030.d:
Job Summary

PT Multi Farmindo Jaya is seeking a dedicated and highly skilled Technical Supervisor (Technical SPV) for our HC Lengkong unit. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing and managing the technical operations, maintenance, and engineering activities at the facility. Your primary objective will be to ensure maximum operational efficiency, minimize equipment downtime, and maintain strict adherence to safety, quality, and environmental standards.

Job Responsibilities

* Oversee the daily technical and maintenance operations of the HC Lengkong facility to ensure optimal production efficiency.
* Develop, implement, and monitor preventive and corrective maintenance schedules for all machinery and utilities.
* Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and technical breakdowns promptly to minimize production downtime.
* Lead and supervise a team of technicians, providing them with guidance, training, and performance evaluations.
* Ensure all technical and engineering activities comply with company standards, occupational health and safety (K3) regulations, and biosafety protocols.
* Manage technical inventory, spare parts procurement, and maintenance budgets effectively.
* Analyze equipment performance and recommend technical upgrades or process improvements to enhance productivity.
* Prepare regular technical reports regarding equipment status, maintenance activities, and resource utilization for management review.

Job Qualifications

* Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
* At least 3 years of working experience in a supervisory technical or maintenance role, preferably within the livestock, feedmill, food manufacturing, or agribusiness industry.
* Strong knowledge of PLC, electrical systems, automation, pneumatics, hydraulics, and general machinery maintenance.
* Proven leadership and team management skills with the ability to direct and motivate technical staff.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Familiarity with Occupational Health and Safety (K3) standards and implementations.
* Good communication skills and proficiency in using computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS) or MS Office.
* Willingness to be placed and work at the HC Lengkong facility.

wo-klbf-JR26_001635.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Assist in managing product innovation and development activities and projects.
- Analyze innovation data and prepare detailed reports.
- Support the development and implementation of innovation strategies.
- Maintain accurate innovation records and documentation.
- Conduct innovation analysis and provide insights to the innovation team.
- Ensure compliance with innovation standards and company policies.

- Membantu dalam pengelolaan aktivitas dan proyek inovasi dan pengembangan produk.
- Menganalisis data inovasi dan menyiapkan laporan terperinci.
- Mendukung pengembangan dan pelaksanaan strategi inovasi.
- Memelihara catatan dan dokumentasi inovasi yang akurat.
- Melakukan analisis inovasi dan memberikan wawasan kepada tim inovasi.
- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar inovasi dan kebijakan perusahaan.

KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
